ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/off-white) pixels comprise approximately 85% of the visible surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels forming a high-contrast border along the trailing edge and distal tips (approx. 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous areas across the main body of both lobes. Low-intensity black bands follow the trailing edge and extend into the distal tips. Two isolated low-intensity circular spots (points) are located in the lower central region near the peduncle insertion.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 65 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel amplitudes along the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged macro-notches are visible on the interior edge of the left lobe (image-right) and scattered along the right lobe (image-left).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave mathematical curve from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparsely distributed circular high-contrast and low-chroma (tan/grey) pixel clusters are visible across the interior ventral surface, particularly in the medial regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent, symmetrical low-intensity circular spots located near the base of the fluke. Irregular, thick black pigmentation along the trailing edges transitioning into the white surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific spatial configuration of the two high-contrast black dots near the lower center of the fluke is a unique identifier.
